timing.scope: host CPU wall time inside this worker; not spacecraft latency

denominators.utilization_while_pending: busy during steps that began with READY/RUNNING work on that node / those steps' seconds

experiment.routing_information: current global link graph and predicted ground windows; instantaneous telemetry; no control-plane cost

transport.compression_assumption: Uncompressed/compressed size ratio; fixed modeling assumption, not measured codec performance
transport.inference_rule: bands/bits_per_sample define model input and VRAM proxy, independently of native transport
transport.compute_rule: Per-window processing proxy; not a measured native PAN/MS pipeline; decode/pansharpen cost not modeled

experiment.result_merge_model: all window outputs required; global merge charged by fixed aggregation_delay_s; no image inference or accuracy validation
